title: Talent Acquisition
description:
**Job Title**
 Talent Acquisition
   

  

**About The Company**
 Harjai Technologies is a global IT staffing and solutions provider with three decades of experience, operating since 1995\. We help enterprises design, build, and scale IT projects through Global Capability Center (GCC) setup, end\-to\-end IT solutions, and Interview\-as\-a\-Service, serving 200\+ clients across BFSI, pharma, healthcare, manufacturing, and technology, among 15\+ industries. With around 1,500 employees and offices in Tampa, Dubai, and Mumbai, we combine deep domain expertise with a fast, reliable delivery mode.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a dedicated Talent Acquisition professional to manage end\-to\-end IT recruitment processes. This role is crucial for identifying and securing top technical talent for our contract staffing and C2H requirements, ensuring our clients receive suitable candidates efficiently.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Handle end\-to\-end IT recruitment for contract staffing and C2H requirements.
* Understand client/job requirements and identify suitable technical candidates.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, internal databases and networking.
* Coordinate candidate interviews with clients and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.


**Requirements**
* 2–4 years of experience in IT Recruitment / IT Contract Staffing.
* Strong experience in Contract Staffing / C2H hiring is mandatory.
* Good understanding of IT technologies and technical job roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn and other recruitment portals.
* Any graduate.
* Strong sourcing, screening, and candidate engagement skills.


**Nice to Have**
* Naukri
* LinkedIn


**Location \& Work Mode**
 Malad, India — ONSITE
   

  

**Employment Type**
 FULL\_TIME
